title: Resolved radial counting ensemble: candidate contract review
provenance: New researcher-owned hypothesis under the explicit state-selection/cutoff redesign review goal; not an inherited theorem or physical owner law.

independent_motivation.reason: The source has two distinct radial controls: an amplitude range R_max and resolution M_psi. A discretization of a fixed amplitude coordinate should enlarge the range while shrinking R_max/M_psi. This criterion concerns coordinate resolution, not a desired Gibbs expectation, and was not chosen from candidate outputs.
independent_motivation.selection_boundary: Counting reference remains an explicit hypothesis, not a uniquely selected ensemble. This review considers exactly one coordinate-resolution path and no alternative priors.
new_assumptions: The dyadic resolved radial path below replaces only the separately tested OMC-010 restricted path for this new study.
Amplitude-based bounded cylinders define the new test topology. This is an explicit new observable contract, not silent identification with raw R-488 integer labels.

scope.geometry: Exactly G_n of PAH-OMC-004 with n>=2, the same oriented edges, split triangles, unsplit frontier square and anchors O,C.
scope.dimension_volume: Finite relational two-cell strip; n is exhaustion, not physical dimension, lattice spacing or physical volume.
scope.configuration: At every n,j use all PAH-001 tuples with ell_v=0,...,M_psi; Q=sum ell is deterministic; phases at zero amplitude remain labelled; no gauge quotient and no optional probe.
scope.functional: Exactly PAH-001 /functional_or_action/formula, evaluated at these original allowed regulator values; no term, coefficient, finite part, counterterm or Jacobian is added.
scope.generator: Exactly PAH-001 /dynamics/generator and its original move families, inverse channels, beta, nu and mobility. One radial move transfers one ell quantum. No acceleration of time or rescaling of rates is allowed.
scope.projection: Exactly the finite Z_2 gauge and anchor-automorphism Reynolds projection on each component; no new physical projection.
scope.state: Z_(n,j,Q)=sum_(q(x)=Q) exp(-F_(n,j)(x)); Z_(n,j)=sum_Q Z_(n,j,Q); w_Q=Z_Q/Z; mu_(n,j)(x)=exp(-F_(n,j)(x))/Z_(n,j). All Q from 0 to |V_n|M_psi are included.
scope.reference: Labelled finite counting measure. A common mesh factor (R_max/M_psi)^|V_n| may cancel from numerator and denominator when analyzing sums, but is not a sector prior or a polar radial Jacobian.
scope.time_boundary: Stationary finite initial law mu_(n,j), t>=0, no terminal conditioning. External stochastic time only.
scope.limit_order: j->infinity at each fixed n, followed by n->infinity only if the first limit and a uniform nondegeneracy estimate are proved. K,M_s,epsilon,beta remain fixed. No reversed order, full joint local-cutoff, lattice or aperture limit is claimed.
scope.state_topology_target: Local bounded continuous functions of amplitudes r_v, aperture labels and closed Z_2 holonomies, with gauge and anchor invariance. This is a new state-comparison topology, not an admitted completed generator core.

observable_contract.threshold_role: The fixed unit threshold defines a bounded witness in the source amplitude units; it is an inserted test convention, not a fitted physical scale.
observable_contract.old_witness_firewall: At j=0, R_max=M_psi=1 and b_v=ell_v. At j>0, b_v is NOT ell_v, ell_v/M_psi or a regulator-independent raw integer cylinder. Report these distinctions; no R-488 or R-508 conclusion is revised.
observable_contract.holonomies: Retain exactly H_0,H_1 from PAH-OMC-008; K remains 2. They are controls, not matter nondegeneracy evidence.
observable_contract.state_embedding: On a fixed graph the dyadic set injection ell_v -> 2 ell_v from j to j+1 preserves r_v; all other labels are retained. It is not a coarse Gibbs pushforward, a root map, a charge-preserving map or a generator intertwiner.
observable_contract.exhaustion_map: At each fixed j retain old coordinates under the OMC-004 neutral restriction and recompute the grade. Old exact-intertwining and C_sw=540 results are reference-only outside their M_psi=1 scope.

future_discriminating_gate.question: Does there exist c>0 independent of n>=2 with liminf_(j->infinity) mu_(n,j)(b_v^2)>=c for both v=a,d, with tight fixed-n amplitude laws?
future_discriminating_gate.why_not_a_finite_table: A bounded coordinate witness existing in each finite set and a finite positive Gibbs weight do not prove this inequality.
future_discriminating_gate.candidate_failure: An exact vanishing bound or counterexample to the stated uniform lower bound rejects this candidate for its stated test, not all PAH laws.
future_discriminating_gate.hold: Without the amplitude-tail and local small-ball estimates retain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE for nondegeneracy; do not infer acceptance from registration, finite normalization or grid resolution.
future_discriminating_gate.follow_on: Only after this necessary gate may a separate Cauchy/common-state/stationarity question be proposed. It is not included or solved by this contract.

review_budget: One candidate, source/coordinate/rate-preservation audit and one exact independent contract check; no partition sweep, replacement-prior search, theorem promotion or synthesis PDF in this planning review.
falsifiers: Any parent hash mismatch or change to functional, couplings, move families, mobilities or time units.
An undeclared sector prior, chemical potential, radial Jacobian, gauge quotient or removal of zero-amplitude phase labels.
The declared path fails either unbounded range or vanishing radial spacing.
A raw-ell, normalized-ell or amplitude observable is silently substituted for another.
The state injection is treated as rootwise generator compatibility or old C_sw=540 is imported beyond its proved path.
A finite test is called the uniform small-ball theorem, or limits are interchanged.
Post-test changes to the path or witness intended to rescue the chosen output without a new version.
non_claims: The candidate and new observable topology are not mathematically admitted by registration.
PAH-OMC-014 remains unresolved; R-508 remains valid; T-054 active gate and all claim tiers remain unchanged.
No infinite-volume dynamics, full joint regulator removal, continuum, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang-Mills, mass gap or TOE conclusion.
No Q3LOCK input; no observation fit, prediction credit or reinterpretation of Markov time.
